summary_1line: Garuda describes the sacred features of the western and northern quarters, detailing their deities, myths, cosmic geography, and holy abodes.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra secretly cuts the sleeping pregnant Diti’s womb, from which the forty-nine Maruts arise.
Shiva stands upon snowy Kailasa as the river Ganga descends from heaven onto his matted hair before flowing to Earth.
The sun sinks toward Mount Asta in the western ocean as twilight spreads and night and sleep emerge over the world.
